scene_objects_dimensions_check.name: scene_objects_dimensions_check
scene_objects_dimensions_check.value: "scene_objects"."width" > 0 AND "scene_objects"."height" > 0 AND "scene_objects"."opacity" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "scene_objects"."rotation" BETWEEN -360000 AND 360000

tokens_dimensions_check.name: tokens_dimensions_check
tokens_dimensions_check.value: "tokens"."width" BETWEEN 0.25 AND 100 AND "tokens"."height" BETWEEN 0.25 AND 100 AND "tokens"."opacity" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "tokens"."rotation" BETWEEN -360000 AND 360000

tokens_resources_check.name: tokens_resources_check
tokens_resources_check.value: jsonb_typeof("tokens"."resources") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("tokens"."resources") = 2 AND ("tokens"."resources"->0->>'current')::integer BETWEEN 0 AND ("tokens"."resources"->0->>'maximum')::integer AND ("tokens"."resources"->1->>'current')::integer BETWEEN 0 AND ("tokens"."resources"->1->>'maximum')::integer
